newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Warburg reinstates airline coverage.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Warburg reinstates airline coverage.

text.p: -- S.G. Warburg analyst Timothy Rose said the brokerage reinstated coverage of the U.S. airline industry after an eight-month hiatus.

-- "The skew of our recommendations to the positive underlines our belief that the U.S. airline sector as a whole has in the region of 10 percent upside, relative both to the rest of the market and to the global industry," Ross said.
-- Following are rating on individual companies:
-- AMR Corp was reinstated as buy;
-- Delta Air Lines Corp was reinstated as add;
-- Southwest Airlines Co was reinstated as hold;
-- Northwest Airlines Corp was reinstated as add;
-- UAL Corp was reinstated as buy;
-- USAir Group Inc was reinstated as hold.
-- AMR was up two at 93-3/4; Delta was up 2-1/8 at 77; Southwest was up 1/8 at 24-3/8; Northwest was unchanged at 39-7/8; UAL was up 2-1/2 at 62; USAir was up 3/4 at 25-5/8.
